title: GTA 6's Raul Bautista: The Bank Robber Whose Recklessness Raises the Stakes 💰 #Shorts
description:
Meet Raul Bautista, GTA 6's veteran bank robber: confident, charming, cunning, and always recruiting talent for risky jobs. According to Rockstar's official character page, his recklessness raises the stakes with every score, and his crew will eventually have to double down or walk away.
